speaker: Ma'kleou
line_text: You shouldn't sneak up on people like that. Bad for the circulation, you know. Behold the ruin nethicite has wrought on Nabudis. No shadow of its glory remains. It is a spawning pool for creatures that feed on Mist. If you hold life dear, you will turn back... Me? I am Ma'kleou. I await the coming of a hero. One to destroy the creatures sealed in Nabudis. We foresaw the coming of a hero, and by way of preparation I bade my disciples fetch the keys that will break the seals within Nabudis. Roh'kenmou and Roh'kenmu are loyal, but it cannot be said they are quick. You may yet see them returning from this task. / Behold the ruin nethicite has wrought on Nabudis. No shadow of its glory remains. If you hold life dear, you will turn back... Is there something you would ask me? (choices: Who are you? / Why are you here? / Not really.) / I am Ma'kleou. I wait here for my two disciples, Roh'kenmou and Roh'kenmu, to return. / I wait here for my two disciples, Roh'kenmou and Roh'kenmu, to return. They bring me keys of great importance. These keys open doors binding terrible beasts deep within Nabudis. I must see the keys in the hands of the hero. You may come across my disciples on your travels. They are loyal, but slow, you see. / I see. Then you would do well to leave. / I have spoken with Roh'kenmou and Roh'kenmu, and we are in agreement. The hero we have waited for is you. The Medallion of Bravery has spoken to Roh'kenmou, and the Medallion of Love to Roh'kenmu. They both speak your name. The keys must go to you. / Two years ago nethicite destroyed the city. From the whirling Mist left in the wake of destruction, three fell beasts emerged. Humbaba, Fury, and Chaos. Beasts with strength enough to lay waste to the entire world, loosed by hume rage. We survived the fall of Nabudis, and found the beasts waiting. After a battle spanning many days, we at last sealed them within the ruins. We changed the keys of the seals into medallions, secreting them away where they would remain safe. But the Mist in the ruins grows deeper with each passing day. In time, the bonds will weaken and break. We will not be able to repel them again. We must see the medallions in the hands of a hero who might defeat the beasts. The prophecy foretold the coming of a hero, and a hero is come. The Medallions of Love and Bravery have named you that hero. Only the Medallion of Might remains. In fact, it waits here in the Nabreus Deadlands... / The Medallion of Might rests within a small shrine in a holy place we call Overlooking Eternity. There it waits for the hero to find it. Once, a bridge rose from here to this holy place, but it is no more. You must cross the Deadlands afoot to reach it now. / By reaching this holy place will you prove you are worthy of the Medallion of Might, hero. There, in Overlooking Eternity, we will await your coming. Roh'kenmou, Roh'kenmu. Let us go. / You shouldn't sneak up on people like that. Bad for the circulation, you know. What's this? You have met Roh'kenmou? I see. So you helped him recover the Medallion of Bravery... A most curious coincidence... / I see. So you helped Roh'kenmou recover the Medallion of Bravery... A most curious coincidence... / You shouldn't sneak up on people like that. Bad for the circulation, you know. What's this? You have met Roh'kenmu? I see. So you helped him recover the Medallion of Love... A most curious coincidence... / I see. So you helped Roh'kenmu recover the Medallion of Love... A most curious coincidence... / Is there something you would ask me? (choices: Who are you? / Why are you here? / Not really.)
